purpose: Production geometry contract for Isabel's monitor wall and surrounding cabinetry.

rules: All four screens use identical dimensions.
Screen planes stay perfectly rectangular and are never perspective-baked textures.
Screen content remains independent live web/data content.
No screen asset may change the physical monitor group dimensions.
Reveal width is uniform on top, bottom, left, and right.
Reveal must not read gray or cream under neutral office lighting.
Reveal is separate physical geometry from cabinetry and screen glass.

cabinetry.monitor_surround: built-in millwork framing the white reveal
rules: Cabinetry surrounds but never overlaps the white reveal.
Monitor group stays centered on the back wall.
Millwork depth must create believable shadow lines without hiding the screen edges.
Do not merge cabinetry, reveal, and monitors into one mesh.
All four bezels must match exactly.
Frame must remain visually subordinate to the white reveal.

acceptance_tests: All four screens measure 16:9 within tolerance.
Monitor group is centered on back wall.
White reveal is uniform on all four outer sides.
Cabinetry does not cover or distort screen edges.
No monitor or bezel is skewed relative to the others.
Live screen content remains readable from CAMERA_ARRIVAL.
